title: The cavalry rides into Yellowstone #Shorts
description:
August 17, 1886. Captain Moses Harris rode into Mammoth with fifty men of the First U.S. Cavalry. His office was a broken-down blacksmith shop, and the Army would run Yellowstone for 32 years.

▶ Full documentary (Part 2, When the Cavalry Guarded the Geysers): https://youtu.be/P99Gu3GCZVw
